messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "600 mg orally with the evening meal on day 2"
set: ["600 mg orally with the evening meal on day 2", "300 mg orally with the evening meal on day 1", "1800 mg orally with the evening meal on day 15", "500 mg orally once a day with evening meal", "1800 mg orally once daily with the evening meal", "900 mg orally with the evening meal on days 3 through 6", "1200 mg orally with the evening meal on days 7 through 10", "1500 mg orally with the evening meal on days 11 through 14", "titrated to 1800 mg orally once daily with the evening meal", "should be taken with food, with the evening meal", "300 mg orally 2 times a day on day two", "600 mg orally 2 times a day (1200 mg/day total) from day 4 onward", "300 mg orally on day one", "600 mg", "30 mg orally 2 times a day", "600 mg orally once each morning on days 1 to 3"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
